gancho: Jackals howled by the tombs at night, so the Egyptians gave their dead a jackal-headed guardian. Follow Anubis from the embalming room into the Duat, past crocodiles, snakes and gates with frightening names.
Sources: Plutarch (On Isis and Osiris), Herodotus (Histories 2), the Pyramid Texts and the Book of the Dead (spells 31–33, 51–53, 144–147).
